description: Angular component for a notification recipient dialog, managing notification target configurations, form interactions, and saving logic within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: RecipientNotificationDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for handling notification recipient dialog, including form setup, dynamic form control enabling/disabling, and save/cancel operations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, and subscribes to form value changes for dynamic behavior.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Prepares form data and calls the notification service to save the notification target, then closes the dialog.

methods.name: isSysAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has system administrator authority.

methods.name: allowNotificationTargetConfigTypes
methods.description: Returns allowed notification target configuration types based on user authority.
